# sonarqube_qualityprofile_activate_rule (Resource)

Activates a rule in a quality profile. Severity and parameters change in place. Import ID: `profile_key/rule_key`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sonarqube_qualityprofile" "java" {
  name     = "Company Java"
  language = "java"
}

resource "sonarqube_qualityprofile_activate_rule" "cognitive_complexity" {
  key      = sonarqube_qualityprofile.java.key
  rule     = "java:S3776"
  severity = "CRITICAL"
  params   = "Threshold=10"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Quality profile key.
- `rule` (String) Rule key, e.g. `java:S1144`.

### Optional

- `params` (String) Parameters as `key1=value1;key2=value2`. When omitted, parameters are not tracked.
- `reset` (String) Reset severity and parameters of an inherited rule to the parent's values (`true`/`false`).
- `severity` (String) Severity override. When omitted, the rule's default applies and drift is not tracked.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this resource in Terraform state.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sonarqube_qualityprofile_activate_rule.example 'AY1234567890abcdef/java:S3776'
```
